author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Companies are rehiring former employees they previously laid off, fired or watched leave — and “boomerang employees” are becoming a bigger part of hiring again.

That sounds like good news.

Until you look at why companies love bringing former workers back.

They already know how the company works.

They already know the systems.

They already know the culture.

The company already knows their work history.

Training and onboarding can be much cheaper.

And in a brutal job market, the former employee may be much more willing to come back than they would have been a few years ago.

In this video, we’re talking about boomerang employees, rehiring after layoffs, Amazon reaching back out to former workers, AI, hiring costs, employee loyalty and why companies have such a strong incentive to bring back people they already know.

The corporate version of boomerang hiring usually sounds very wholesome.

title: COMPANIES ARE REHIRING THE PEOPLE THEY LAID OFF
